not_indexed.evidence_against: No supported item extracted in this bounded source reading; this does not establish that none exists.

open_questions.text: Validate the measurement bridge with independently captured intended events.

cards.plain_language: The isolated scorer follows marker checks in stdout and the oversight log.

review.four_verification_axes: Canonical assessments remain unchanged; this reading supplies no new kernel check, system correspondence or empirical validation.

source_checks.inspection_limit: Matching-hash original copy inspected in project archive. Upstream checkout is not tracked in this worktree; reproduce from the pinned upstream URL. No live system execution.

cards.statement_scope: Pinned _evaluate_side_task; called in ATTACK-mode scoring after execution checks.
cards.title: Scorer marker event

scope: View-only AI source analysis of exactly 25 existing records. No new canonical record, source ref, link, identity or verification status. Does not count as independent human task evaluation.
source_reference_rule: Items attach through exact existing source_ref. source_check_id resolves the actually inspected supplemental span; it must be shown when using an enrichment, especially when the canonical anchor is abstract-only. Supplemental inspections never rewrite canonical source refs.

useful_card_checklist.criterion: Existing stable ID and recorded state attach to the exact joined snapshot.
At least one source reference matches the existing record exactly.
A specified original source span, not only title or search metadata, was read by AI.
A concise interpretation and explicit source/model scope are present.
Each research field contains supported text or an explicit not_indexed reason.
No inferred source, system or empirical PASS is inherited from a formal result.
Human primary-source review of this enrichment is recorded before calling its meaning human-reviewed.
